title: Georgia's Tallest Waterfall and Scenic Blue Ridge
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the stunning natural beauty of North Georgia with a visit to Georgia's tallest waterfall; Amicalola Falls. Enjoy a couple of hours exploring & shopping in the picturesque mountain town of Blue Ridge. Enjoy lunch from a variety of options at your expense. This small-group tour is perfect for nature lovers and shopping enthusiasts, providing a unique opportunity to mix nature with an adorable & popular town.

- Discover a magnificent waterfall in the foothills of the Appalachian Mountains
- Enjoy hiking trails suitable for all skill levels with breathtaking views
- Visit the charming town of Blue Ridge for lunch and shopping
- Small group size (maximum of 9 participants) for a personalized experience
